component.name: 3D Ambient Player
component.summary: Dedicated Standalone 3D Ambient & Binaural Soundscape Player

description.p: 3D Ambient Player is a lightweight, distraction-free standalone soundscape player designed for deep relaxation, focus, meditation, and sleep.

ul.li: Distraction-free ambient player with breathing halo artwork visualizer
Atmosphere Stem Mixer for adjusting individual environmental elements
Smart Sleep Timer with gentle 15-second audio fade-out
Smart ambient lighting sync with Philips Hue Bridge and Home Assistant
Binaural 3D spatial headphone audio and stereo speaker playback

description.p: Initial standalone release of 3D Ambient Player.
